messages:
incident-bot: ALERT — billing-metering: burst of late emits detected; overage flags spiking for multiple customers. severity=P2. dashboard: https://redwood.app/dash/alerts/1719 :rotating_light:
helena: taking this. paging oncall and billing engs. switching to #incidents-1719209876 for live triage :wave:
sam: reported customer-visible overages or just internal flags? :eyes:
helena: internal flags right now but we see a subset of customers receiving automated overage emails earlier; root cause looks like delayed emitter messages that later replayed, causing duplicate counts in the tally service
chen: can you paste the alert query/result? want to check if it's emitter replays or aggregation double-counting
helena: short snippet from the alert: ```sql
select customer_id, sum(tokens) as tokens_today, count(distinct emit_id) as emits
from metering.events where ts > now() - interval '2 hours' group by customer_id order by tokens_today desc limit 10;
```
helena: for top customers emits jumped from ~1k -> 4k in a 5m window then decreased — suggests replayed batch window
billing-bot: telemetry: emitter-proxy shows 1.8M late messages re-ingested between 1719205000-1719209000; dedupe hits low (~4%). full query: https://redwood.app/telemetry/q/emit-replay-1719
jen: if dedupe rate is low we might be double-counting at aggregator. immediate mitigations: 1) pause auto-overage emails (support/comms) 2) enable aggregator dedupe-mode flag (if still healthy) 3) scale consumer group to drain backlog faster
meera: pausing auto-notify: can do now — will open the cancel and templated message. which customers should we notify proactively?
sam: notify customers who got emails and those with >10% delta in token delta. meera, use template: "We observed an incorrect overage notification caused by a delayed ingestion issue; no action needed; we'll follow up with corrected billing."
chen: runbook link: https://runbooks.redwood/incident/metering-dedupe. Suggested commands: ```bash
# enable dedupe flag on aggregator
api put /config/aggregator?dedupe=true --env prod
# re-run backfill (idempotent)
./backfill --service=tally --start=2026-03-20T00:00:00Z --end=2026-03-20T03:00:00Z --dedupe=true
```
helena: putting ops steps into incident doc and assigning owners. helena = incident lead; jen = billing eng to run backfill; chen = SRE for scaling & health checks; meera = comms/support lead
jen: starting backfill dry-run now, will post logs. ETA for dry-run 10m
jen: dry-run logs: ```
INFO backfill: scanning 3,242,001 events
INFO backfill: dedupe window applied, estimated corrections = -12,345 tokens
WARN backfill: some emits missing emit_id, skipping
```
helena: good. if dry-run looks sane, run full backfill and produce corrected invoices/flags. meanwhile meera please send hold-notice to affected customers, avoid mentioning root technicals
meera: sent hold-notice to support; ticket created: https://redwood.app/tickets/INC-4821. template used and copy to CS: @cs-team
sam: product ask — add a short note in the customer portal banner after resolution. tagging for post-incident actions: stronger dedupe heuristics, emitter heartbeat alert improvements, and test for replay scenarios
chen: scaling consumer group + raised replicas of aggregator x3. monitoring bus: latency and duplicate-counts trending down. will keep watch for 30m
helena: summary/action items: pause auto-notify (meera) done; backfill (jen) in progress; scale & health (chen) done; customer comms open (meera); follow-up RCA to be scheduled by sam. moving to status=mitigating. will update when backfill completes and when corrected flags issued. :white_check_mark:
